cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One Sunday visit a month and you get the spare key back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I work Sundays. I just need to collect my records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Saturday lunch, then. That gets you through the front door; the records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring enough lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay for one side of an album and I'll help carry the boxes.
